'''Preston Pendergraft''' is a Star Wars CCG player named in [[Travis Merkle]]'s Memorial Day 1999 report on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. He played [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] with Clouds against Merkle's [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]].<ref name="mem">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Memorialdayreport99.htm Memorial Day Tourney Report], The Outer Rim ([[Travis Merkle]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234402/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Memorialdayreport99.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
